changed_in.5.3: Requires each bound to be an integer, or a float sitting exactly on one, and requires the span between the two bounds to fit in an integer; earlier versions accept any number.
changed_in.5.4: Draws on a generator built into Lua rather than on the one the C library supplies, and starts that generator from a seed picked at run time, so a program that never seeds it still gets a different sequence on each run. A single argument of `0` now asks for an integer with every bit drawn at random instead of describing an empty range, and the two bounds may span the whole integer range.
